{{Quote|Commander Bylsma, something has ''torn a hole'' in Deck eight-five-nine!|Captain Ogden to Commander Bylsma|<ref name="InRef1">[[Invasion: Rescues 1|''Invasion: Rescues'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Deck eight-five-nine''' was a deck aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dibrook Space Station]] orbiting the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dibrook]].<ref name="InRef1" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Invasion: Rescues]]'' are after the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', while [[Invasion: Revelations 1|''Invasion: Revelations'' 1]] depicts the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]] from ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]'', placing the entire ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'' series in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> during an attack on the station by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]], Deck eight-five-nine was breached by the invaders and a number of New Republic [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] were abducted through the resulting hull breach. The damage was reported to station [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Bylsma (New Republic)|Bylsma]] by his subordinate<ref name="InRef1" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ogden (captain)|Ogden]].<ref name="InRef2">[[Invasion: Rescues 2|''Invasion: Rescues'' 2]]</ref>
